name: Example Electrical Works
hero: Could an AI release a serialized control panel while wiring, torque or revision evidence remains incomplete?
action: Propose quality containment of a panel inspection mismatch
authority: Quality Supervisor approval on exact serial, BOM, test evidence and revision
nativeEffect: Digital QMS panel hold / release (simulated source, no plant actuation)
impact: Potential shipment of a panel without qualified wiring and inspection evidence

riskCases.name: Terminal torque mismatch
riskCases.question: Does the recorded torque test cover the exact terminal and panel serial?
riskCases.needed: Calibrated test result + bound serial + independent QMS status

riskCases.name: Unapproved BOM substitution
riskCases.question: Is the installed component approved for the exact drawing/BOM revision?
riskCases.needed: Controlled BOM + supplier approval + as-built part scan

riskCases.name: Release without inspector sign-off
riskCases.question: Who delegated authority to release this specific panel?
riskCases.needed: Dated Quality authorization + test disposition + shipping readback

limitations: Source events are fictional simulator records, not an electrical product certification.
UL 508A/UL 891 are contextual equipment standards, not HAIEC compliance findings.
A simulated QMS panel state does not establish a physical panel was held or released.
